name: Divinity

frame.name: Judgment
frame.description: Sustained damage with this weapon envelops the target in a field that weakens and stuns them. Strong against [Disruption] Overload Champions.

perks.name: Polygonal Rifling
perks.description:
Barrel optimized for recoil reduction.
  •  Increases stability

perks.name: Penance
perks.description: Targets under the effects of Judgment long enough are struck with a burst of damage.

perks.name: Composite Stock
perks.description:
This weapon has a versatile dual-purpose stock.
  •  Slightly increases stability
  •  Slightly increases handling speed

flavor: Calibrate reality. Seek inevitability. Embody divinity.

catalyst.name: Divinity Catalyst
catalyst.description:
Dealing repeated damage with this weapon inflicts Jolt. 

While amplified, Jolt is applied faster.
Dealing a portion of the magazine as precision damage grants this weapon bonus damage. The shot count is reset whenever the weapon is reloaded or stowed.
